metadataEquivalence.equivalence: Restoring this one metadata value reproduces every frozen byte. All mathematical functions and the other five game definitions are unchanged.

analysis.completeRound: One paid start and up to six free unlocks; cashout is available after any success. A trap ends the round with zero return.
analysis.adaptivePolicies: For every revealed history, every pair has two safe trap locations among four independent next-row locations. The unfloored conditional return is a martingale after the initial 2% edge. Every adaptive pair choice and stopping time from one to six is covered.
analysis.integerBounds: For every positive integer stake s: 0.98 - 1/s < RTP <= 0.98. All declared wallet stakes have exact 98% RTP at every stopping depth.
analysis.boundsKind: Exact enumeration and integer settlement; no Monte Carlo confidence interval.
